summary: Define split-plan lifecycle for oversized in-progress work

delivery.outcome: Stream a validated material slice now and recover the remaining oversized work as a deterministic bounded successor DAG.
nonGoals: Do not execute Git, GitHub, shell, worktree or ticket-allocation operations from this contract
Do not store prompts, command transcripts, secrets or absolute host paths
Do not let a parent orchestration PR contain only ticket or status carriers

architecture.decision: Represent a split as an inert canonical AST whose parent slice is publishable material and whose preallocated successor graph is recovered by terminal-receipt subtraction.
dataChanges: Successor nodes bind allocation and optional terminal receipts
architecture.rollback: Revert the schema, grammar, semantic validator and split-plan guidance together.

validation.evidence: Canonical positive document plus adversarial carrier-only, unsafe-path, overlapping-scope, dangling-dependency, allocation, receipt and replay cases.
